title: Separate optional JEV advice from truthful agent presence
context: The user wants JEV in real decisions and real-time agent duration/activity across coding clients.
decision: Expose JEV as a visible advisory MCP tool with secretsafe usage metadata, and add a dedicated five-second MCP connection presence signal rather than treating twenty-minute work leases as process liveness.
consequences: JEV remains fail-open and cannot grant permission; dashboard reports CONNECTED, IDLE, STALE or ENDED and labels MCP client identity as self-reported. Raw prompts, code, candidate descriptions and credentials are never persisted.
